answer: Cosignatures are collected in sparrow, verified in raven, and reef names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 10 submissions per epoch. The attacker spends 226 dollars and 6 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
